# Tidepool Landing Page Build Plan

**Palette:** Sand (#F6F1E9) base, ink-teal (#0E3B43) text/panels, seafoam (#A8DADC) accents, coral (#FF6B5B) for CTAs only. **Type:** Fraunces (serif) headlines, Inter body. **Imagery:** soft wave gradients, real product UI in rounded frames—no stock photos.

## 1. Hero (full viewport)
Split layout: headline left, floating product mockup right, sitting on a subtle animated tide gradient (seafoam → sand). Copy leads with outcome: *"Plan the week together, without another meeting."* Subhead: "Tidepool gives small teams one shared view of the week—what's happening, who's swamped, what can wait." CTA: coral button, "Start free — no card needed."

## 2. Proof strip
Thin band, small grayscale logos + one line: "Trusted by 2,000+ teams of 3–15." Low contrast; lets hero breathe.

## 3. Problem framing
Centered single column, short. Headline: *"Mondays shouldn't feel like riptides."* Three pain points as inline text with small line icons: calendar sprawl, invisible workloads, lost context between tools.

## 4. How it works
Three horizontal cards connected by a wave line. Tide-anchored naming: **Friday Pulse** (team shares plans), **Monday Map** (week appears in one board), **Midweek Drift Check** (async adjustments). Each card: seafoam number, two-sentence explanation, tiny UI snippet.

## 5. Feature bento grid
Five tiles of varying size: shared weekly board (large, live mockup), workload balance (heat-style visualization), async check-ins, Slack/Calendar integrations (small logo tiles). Serif micro-headlines, one sentence each.

## 6. Testimonial
Full-width ink-teal panel, white text, one large pull quote: *"We killed our Monday standup. Nobody misses it."* — name, team, role. Wave-edge divider top and bottom.

## 7. Final CTA
Deep gradient panel, centered: *"Catch your first tide."* Email field + coral button, "Free for teams up to 5." Reassuring microcopy below.

## 8. Footer
Minimal: wordmark, three link columns, quiet wave motif.

# Tidepool — Revised Build Plan

**Adopted from the reference:** narrative hero headline with concrete payoff, a product-mirroring sidebar motif, hand-drawn annotations, monospace pull quotes. **Kept:** nautical palette (distinct from forest green), bento grid, tide-named mechanics.

**Palette:** Sand (#F6F1E9) base, deepened ink-teal (#0B323A), seafoam (#A8DADC), coral (#FF6B5B) for CTAs only. **Type:** Fraunces headlines, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for pull quotes and annotations. **Imagery:** real UI in rounded frames plus hand-drawn arrows and margin notes throughout.

## 1. Hero
Split layout. Left: one long narrative headline telling the full story: *"Bring every person on your team together around one living map of the week that fills itself in as plans change, shows who's swamped before they sink, and quietly does the job of the Monday standup—so nobody finds out about the slip on Friday afternoon."* Coral CTA below. Right: floating product board. A hand-drawn arrow curves from the headline's last line to the board, annotated in mono: *"← this is Tuesday. already sorted."* A vertical **week-spine** runs down the far-left edge: Mon–Fri nodes, today lit seafoam, weekend dashed. The spine persists down the page.

## 2. Proof strip
Unchanged: gray logos, "Trusted by 2,000+ teams of 3–15."

## 3. Problem framing
Centered, tight: *"Mondays shouldn't feel like riptides."* Three pains inline with line icons.

## 4. How it works
**Strengthened:** Friday Pulse, Monday Map, and Midweek Drift Check now hang directly off the week-spine as its Tue/Thu/Fri nodes—the sidebar literally becomes the diagram. Each: seafoam label, two sentences, tiny UI snippet.

## 5. Feature bento
Five tiles, one sentence each. Second annotation added: arrow to the workload tile, mono note: *"Maya's overloaded — drag it to Sam."*

## 6. Testimonial
Ink-teal panel, wave dividers. Pull quote now set large in monospace, like a typed check-in: *"We killed the Monday standup in week one. Friday Pulse takes four minutes."* — name, team, role.

## 7. Final CTA
Gradient panel: *"Catch your first tide."* Email + coral button. Microcopy: "Free for teams up to 5."

## 8. Footer
Week-spine terminates in a checked-off "Week done" node. Minimal links, quiet wave motif.
